## 8.2.1.1 Question 1

##### In real-world analysis, you would inspect all files, not just the first two. Make sure that your code chunk checks all forward and reverse files.

```{r}
# Load the library
library(dada2)
library(phyloseq)

data_dir <- here::here("data/MiSeq_SOP")

# Identify all forward and reverse FASTQ files
fnFs <- sort(list.files(
  data_dir,
  pattern = "_R1_001\\.fastq(\\.gz)?$",
  full.names = TRUE
))

fnRs <- sort(list.files(
  data_dir,
  pattern = "_R2_001\\.fastq(\\.gz)?$",
  full.names = TRUE
))

# Extract sample names
sample.names <- sub(
  "_R1_001\\.fastq(\\.gz)?$",
  "",
  basename(fnFs)
)

# Verify matching forward and reverse reads
stopifnot(length(fnFs) > 0)
stopifnot(length(fnFs) == length(fnRs))

# Plot quality profiles for ALL forward reads
plotQualityProfile(fnFs)

# Plot quality profiles for ALL reverse reads
plotQualityProfile(fnRs)
```
